semantic_diff.name: semantic_diff
evidence: established by byte identity with the no-op rebuild: resource_table

limitations: components: <activity-alias> is not modelled as a component; alias changes are reported by manifest_tree only
native: native code is not analysed; hash and ELF metadata only
resources: res/ binary XML and images are compared by content hash, not decoded; a same-path content change cannot be interpreted semantically
resource_table: not_comparable: resources.arsc differs; its entries are not compared semantically (only byte identity is established)
signature files (META-INF/MANIFEST.MF, *.SF, *.RSA...) are accepted by path; their validity is established by apksigner, not by the diff
verification_matrix.statement: Verification establishes structural/signing validity and that observed differences match the plan and the measured rebuild noise, within the stated comparator coverage. It does not establish that the application is safe.
